title: lotophyllus argenteus subsp. linnaeanus
intro: Lotophyllus argenteus subsp. linnaeanus, commonly known as "Silver Lotus", is a plant species in the genus Lotophyllus, which belongs to the family Apocynaceae. It is used to treat a variety of health issues, including anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness, due to its sedative properties and ability to promote relaxation. The health benefits of Lotophyllus argenteus subsp. linnaeanus include reducing inflammation, acting as an antispasmodic, and exerting antimicrobial effects. The plant's bioactive constituents include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions.
